name: 7qgnnc-context-handoff
goal: When a managed session reaches the context limit, preserve its checkpoint and continue the same Tracker item and model in a fresh session exactly once.

evidence: Runs #1204 and #1219 entered blocked status after saving mandatory context checkpoints. A worker must be able to checkpoint the current owned attempt, leave the item active, and let recovery request a fresh session with the same model.
Extend the existing watchdog-context-handoff workload beyond solicited pane closure to exercise a worker checkpoint filed before the next watchdog sample and the real recovery dispatch path.
